finding: A plain page reload is treated as 'another tab is live'. TAB id is regenerated on every page load (TAB = Math.random()...), so after reload liveElsewhere(m[sessionRunId]) is true (old tab id, beat < 90 s). loadLocal() forks to a new runId and shows the toast 'แบบทดสอบนี้เปิดอยู่อีกแท็บ...'. The original entry stays in ft11_runs as an orphan copy.
repro: audit/conc.js case (a): start 'reloadme', answer 5, reload -> toast shown, sessionStorage ft11_tabrun changes, ft11_runs goes from 1 to 2 entries (reloadme:6, reloadme:5).
suggested_fix: Tell a reload apart from a duplicated tab. Simplest: on pagehide set m[runId].beat = 0 (or delete .tab) so a reload finds the run not-live and re-claims it. A duplicated tab still sees the live beat and forks. Alternatives: keep TAB in sessionStorage and use performance.getEntriesByType('navigation')[0].type==='reload', or use BroadcastChannel to check whether the owner is alive.

finding: Wiping after a reload does not delete the user's data. 'สุ่มชุดใหม่' on the result page and 'ลบความคืบหน้าในเครื่องนี้' on the pause page call wipe(), which deletes only the current (forked) runId. The orphaned original stays. About 90 s later it is offered again. A finished run opens straight to the previous person's result on the next visit, because the boot code calls renderResult() when firstOpen()<0.
repro: audit/conc2.js: (1) finish a 56-item run, reload (still shows the result), click 'สุ่มชุดใหม่'. ft11_runs still has 'wipeafterreload:72'. Open a new tab once beat is older than 90 s and it shows the OLD RESULT. (2) mid-run: reload, answer, pause, 'ลบความคืบหน้า'. The next visit offers 'ทำต่อจากข้อ 6/64'.
suggested_fix: Fix the reload fork above. Also make wipe() delete every entry that descends from this tab's lineage: record parent ids on fork, or delete all runs with the same seed+chosen+L whose tape is a prefix of the current tape. Consider not auto-opening a finished result for a new visitor; show a 'ดูผลครั้งก่อน / เริ่มใหม่' choice instead.

finding: Repeated reloads push other saved runs out of storage. Each reload-fork adds an entry, and writeRuns() keeps only the 6 newest by 'at'. A run someone paused and closed (expecting to resume later) is silently deleted from this browser.
repro: audit/conc.js (a_evict): save a paused run 'paused-other' (4 answers) in one tab and close it. In another tab, reload 6 times while answering. ft11_runs then holds 6 'reloadme' copies and 'paused-other' is gone.
suggested_fix: Fixing the reload fork removes most of this. Also prune forks or duplicates of the same lineage before dropping other runs, and never drop a run whose tape is longer than all its copies.

finding: After a resume link is opened, the #r1... hash stays in the URL and takes priority at boot over local progress. Reloading (or reopening) that tab replays the link's old tape. The answers given since are not shown, and another duplicate run is created each time.
repro: audit/ui.js S3: open a pause link at 12/65, answer 3 (15/65), reload -> 'ทำต่อจากข้อ 12/65'. ft11_runs has 3 entries.
suggested_fix: After consuming #r1 (and #s1), call history.replaceState(null,'',location.pathname+location.search). Or at boot, prefer a local run with the same seed/chosen/L whose tape extends the link's tape.

finding: Status 'ยืนยันแล้ว' (chOK) can appear next to an I/E-conflict warning ('สองส่วนนี้ชี้คนละทาง: ลองอ่านทั้ง X และ <mirror>'). In those cases the share caption/story says 'ไทป์ของฉันใกล้เคียง X / <mirror>', because summaryOf adds alt for flag 'eic'. CH_T itself is applied correctly: status==='confirmed' iff chOK in 1,672 engine runs with 0 mismatches.
repro: audit/results.js (120 injected finished runs): 3 of the 15 'confirmed' results show the conflict warning and an 'ใกล้เคียง' share caption. calib2 (4,800 runs): 37 of 466 confirmed carry 'eic' and 2 carry 'top_changed', which is displayed.
suggested_fix: Either require !eic (and same1) for chOK, or, when confirmed, soften the eic note to informational and do not add alt to the share summary.

finding: decodeShare() checks only the (public, trivial) checksum. It does not range-check the ei digit (0–9 accepted, but EI_BAND_TXT has 5 entries), the bar digits (non-hex gives NaN width), the days field, or the version. A hand-made link renders 'undefined' and 'แชร์เมื่อ NaN/NaN/NaN' on the shared page and in the story image.
repro: audit/ui.js S5: rebuild a real s1 link with ei='9' and a recomputed checksum -> 'undefined' in the text. With bars 'zzzzzzzz' and days 'zzzzzzzzzz' -> 'NaN/NaN/NaN'.
suggested_fix: Validate it: ei in 0..4, each bar /^[0-9a-f]$/, days finite and within range, alt !== code. Return null otherwise.

finding: Resume tape symbols are not validated. valOf('9') gives 7 and valOf('Z') gives NaN, and both are stored as answers. A link with a valid checksum but junk tape is accepted and resumes with out-of-range values in scoring.
repro: audit/conc2.js t_junk: append '9Z' to a real tape, recompute the checksum -> 'ทำต่อจากข้อ 7/56' (2 junk answers accepted).
suggested_fix: In decodeResume, reject any tape char outside [0-4n] that is not part of D<ctx>/K<ctx> with a ctx in CTX_ALL (err 'bad').

finding: When localStorage.setItem throws (quota or blocked), the save fails silently. The pause screen still says 'บันทึกไว้ในแอป/เบราว์เซอร์นี้แล้ว'. The quiz itself keeps working, which is good, but a reload loses everything with no warning.
repro: audit/conc.js (f): setItem throws QuotaExceededError -> no notice; after reload the setup screen shows. (e): storage getters throw -> the quiz works and a pause code is given.
suggested_fix: Use writeRuns()'s return value. On false, show a one-time toast and change the pause copy to 'บันทึกในเครื่องไม่ได้ เก็บลิงก์ไว้'.

finding: Old v10 resume links correctly show 'ลิงก์นี้มาจากแบบทดสอบเวอร์ชันเก่า...', both from the URL and pasted. A v10 in-progress save (localStorage 'ft10_progress') is ignored silently: the user lands on setup with no message. (A future-version r1.c link also shows the 'เวอร์ชันเก่า' text.)
repro: audit/ui.js S4: start v10 in the same origin, answer 4, open r11 -> setup, no warning, ft10_progress still present.
suggested_fix: If ft10_progress exists, show the old-version notice once and remove the key.

finding: Near-ties render as 'ห่าง −0.00' and 'ห่างอันดับ 1 อยู่ 0.00 คะแนน' (gap < 0.005; about 1.4% of 4,800 simulated runs). No undefined, NaN, '−0.0', raw tags or unescaped user text appeared in 120 rendered results plus 3 full UI runs. The seed '<b>&"x'' is escaped correctly.
repro: audit/recs.json: 67 of 4,800 have margin < 0.005. top3Html uses '−' + gap.toFixed(2).
suggested_fix: Show 'คะแนนเท่ากันแทบทุกหลัก' or '<0.01' when gap < 0.005.

finding: The criterion line reads 'ผ่านมากกว่าไทป์คู่แข่งที่ดีที่สุดอย่างน้อย 0 จุด' because CH_T.gap = 0 (the code uses >=, so a tie passes). That reads as a meaningless or contradictory rule.
repro: Any result with phase 2; see the crit string in renderResult.
suggested_fix: When gap is 0, word it as 'ไม่ต่ำกว่าไทป์คู่แข่งที่ดีที่สุด', or drop the clause.

finding: <html> has no lang attribute (lang='th' is only on <main id=app>). The document title and the toast/role=status live region, which is appended to <body>, are outside it. Everything else checked passes: every button, input and link is labelled; scale is role=radiogroup with labelled role=radio buttons; roving tabindex; arrows/Home/End move focus; Enter and Space select; focus moves to the question group on each screen; back button works; scrollWidth is 390 on setup, question, pause, intro, result and shared screens at 390 px.

save(), heartbeat() and wipe() do a read-modify-write of the whole ft11_runs map. Two tabs writing in the same instant can drop the other tab's latest update. The next save repairs it, so the impact is at most one answer if a tab closes right after. Verified in code only; not reproduced.
repro: Code review: readRuns() -> mutate -> writeRuns(JSON of the whole map).
suggested_fix: Store each run under its own key (ft11_run_<id>) plus a small index, so tabs never rewrite each other's entries.
